name: community_garden
title: Community Garden Feedback
description: Help us improve the community garden experience for everyone

questions.question_text: What do you enjoy most about the community garden?
How satisfied are you with the garden overall?
How often do you visit the garden?
Which areas of the garden do you use?

0.response_text: I love the sense of community. Meeting my neighbors while tending plots has been wonderful. We share tips, seeds, and even recipes from what we grow.

3.response_text: We need more water spigots. The single hose connection means long waits during peak hours. A drip irrigation system would be ideal.

0.response_text: The peace and quiet. It's a sanctuary from the noise of the city. Just sitting among the flowers and listening to birds is incredibly calming.

3.response_text: Better communication about work days and events. A shared calendar or message board at the entrance would help everyone stay informed.

0.response_text: Learning to grow my own vegetables has been transformative. I had zero gardening experience and now I'm growing tomatoes, peppers, and herbs successfully.

3.response_text: Install a rainwater collection system. It would be environmentally friendly and reduce our water bill. Also, more accessible water points throughout the garden.

0.response_text: The friendships I've made. My plot neighbors have become some of my closest friends. The garden creates a real sense of belonging in what can feel like an impersonal city.

3.response_text: More shaded seating areas. During summer it gets too hot to rest between tasks. Some benches under trees or a pergola would be fantastic.

0.response_text: Being outdoors and connecting with nature. Watching seeds I planted turn into actual plants feels almost magical. The garden is my therapy.

3.response_text: The watering situation needs improvement. Sometimes the hose doesn't reach my plot and I have to carry heavy watering cans back and forth.

6.response_text: The butterfly garden section is beautiful

0.response_text: The educational aspect. I've learned about composting, companion planting, and seasonal growing. The knowledge-sharing culture here is amazing.

3.response_text: We need a better system for coordinating shared tool usage. Maybe a sign-out sheet or online booking for the rototiller and other expensive equipment.

6.response_text: The seed library is a great addition

0.response_text: Sharing the harvest with my neighbors and seeing children learn where food comes from. The intergenerational connections in this garden are truly special.

3.response_text: Add more benches and maybe a small covered pavilion for gatherings. We often want to sit and chat but there's nowhere comfortable.

6.response_text: The kids' plot is such a wonderful idea

0.response_text: The natural beauty. Watching the seasons change through the garden is meditative. Spring blossoms, summer abundance, autumn colors - each visit feels renewing.

3.response_text: More water access points please. Also the existing spigot sometimes has very low pressure, making watering time-consuming.

0.response_text: Discovering the science of growing food. Understanding soil pH, nutrient cycles, and pest management has been like taking a free university course.

3.response_text: Communication could be much better. I often miss important announcements about plot assignments and seasonal cleanups. An email list or app would help.

6.response_text: Would appreciate a mentorship program for new gardeners

0.response_text: The camaraderie. Everyone helps each other out - sharing surplus produce, lending tools, giving advice. It truly feels like a village within the city.

3.response_text: Better shade structures and comfortable seating. Also a covered area for rainy days when dedicated gardeners still want to work.
